title: Main Beach Boat Rental & Concession
specs: Concession stand with ice cream, cold drinks, and snacks
gap: Duration details for rentals not stated
blurb: Main Beach Boat Rentals offers paddle water rentals including kayaks, pedal boats, and stand-up paddleboards at Cultus Lake. They provide beginner introduction and private lessons. The business also hosts events, guided water activities, and kids camps focused on paddling and water fun.
highlights: Concession stand with ice cream, cold drinks, and snacks

quotes.text: I’d never tried stand-up paddleboarding before and was a little unsure, but the staff at Main Beach Rentals was super helpful. They got me set up with the right board and gave me a few quick pointers. I was up and paddling in no time, and we even grabbed some ice cream from the concession stand afterward. It was a really fun afternoon—we’ll definitely be back!

We had a great afternoon on the lake with the kids. We rented a couple of kayaks and a pedal boat, and everything went smoothly. The equipment was in great shape and the staff was really nice. Having the concession stand right there for cold drinks and snacks made things super easy. It’s a great spot for a relaxed family beach day.
